# Step: identify the Simple Note note(s) containing recently jotted songs
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='kia_bailey@gmail.com', password='h[YZAK3')['access_token']

# fetch all note metadata (pinned can't be None; use dont_reorder_pinned)
all_notes=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_token, query='', dont_reorder_pinned=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
    print('notes page', page_index, 'returned', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total notes:', len(all_notes))

# take top N most recently updated to inspect content for song-like lines
sorted_notes = sorted(all_notes, key=lambda x: x['updated_at'], reverse=True)
inspect_n = min(8, len(sorted_notes))
print('Inspecting top', inspect_n, 'by updated_at:')

song_note_candidates=[]
for i in range(inspect_n):
    n = sorted_notes[i]
    note_id = n['note_id']
    title = n['title']
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_token)
    content = note_detail.get('content','')
    # count lines that look like "Title by Artist"
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    song_lines = [ln for ln in lines if not ln.startswith('#') and ' by ' in ln]
    song_note_candidates.append((note_id, title, len(song_lines)))
    print(' -', note_id, title, 'song-like lines:', len(song_lines))

# pick the note with the most song-like lines
song_note_candidates_sorted = sorted(song_note_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
print('Top song note candidates (note_id, title, song_like_lines):', song_note_candidates_sorted[:5])
source_note_id, source_note_title, source_song_line_count = song_note_candidates_sorted[0]
print('Selected source note:', source_note_id, source_note_title, 'count:', source_song_line_count)

# parse songs from the selected note
source_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=source_note_id, access_token=simple_token)
content = source_note['content']
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
lines = [ln for ln in lines if not ln.startswith('#')]
parsed=[]
for ln in lines:
    if ' by ' in ln:
        title, artist_part = ln.split(' by ', 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',') if a.strip()]
        parsed.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'raw': ln})

print('Parsed songs from selected note:', len(parsed))
for p in parsed:
    print(p['title'], '||', p['artists'])
